opening.argument: The offer is a routine retail promotion: a free $5 Starbucks gift card and 5% off an order are advertised as purchase-linked benefits. The spoken terms define the eligibility condition plainly, stating that the $5 gift cards are available for orders of $35 or more. The promotional code and shopping destination explain how to participate in the stated store offer, while the limited-availability language concerns access to that promotion. The footage also shows an opened envelope containing a Starbucks card marked $5. Nothing described asks viewers to invest money, provide credentials, make a separate payment, or disclose private data.
